$ rea setup --help
exit: 0
--- stdout
rea setup — Configure agent integrations and optional analysis providers

Usage: rea setup [options]

Options:
  --yes, -y                               Approve user-owned setup actions without prompting
  --install-hopper                        Also approve Hopper installation with --yes
  --desktop-build                         Prepare this host for desktop builds: pack REA's build-computer runtime and record the build settings in the selected registrations
  --install-agentenv                      With --desktop-build, also install the agentenv-framework release bundles target with uv
  --client <array>                        Agent integration to configure; repeat for multiple agents
  --skill-client <array>                  Existing client skill destination to update; repeatable
  --tool-families <string>                Comma-separated tool families this registration advertises; omit to preserve the saved selection, or advertise every tool if none is saved. To restore every tool, remove REA_MCP_TOOL_FAMILIES from the client's registration and restart the client.
  --tool-catalog-profile <full|hot-cold>  MCP catalog: full advertises every in-scope tool; hot-cold loads tools on demand and requires client catalog refresh. Omit to preserve the saved profile, or use full if none is saved. Restart the client after changing it.
  --all-detected                          Configure every detected supported agent
  --skill                                 Override the bundled skill included with agent integrations
  --dry-run                               Print the resolved plan without applying it
  --accessible                            Use sequential accessible setup prompts
  --full-report                           With --client or --skill-client, also report the state of every other supported client

Global options (--json, --format, --filter-output, --token-limit, --timings, ...): rea help options
<end>
--- stderr
<end>
